contract.title: Write the support team's first-day guide
contract.goal: Write a one-page guide, docs/onboarding/first-day.md in the Tallowmere repository, that tells a new support agent what to do on their first day.
contract.details: It is for people who have just joined the support team, in plain words with no internal abbreviations. It says that the ticket queue is the Queue tab of the Tallowmere admin, that the support lead gives access, and that the three tools used every day are the ticket queue, the shared support inbox and the team wiki.

criteria.text: The file docs/onboarding/first-day.md exists and gives the queue's place, the person who gives access and the three tools, as the details state them.
The guide fits on one printed page.
